name: Apache JMeter Performance Testing
certifications: No official JMeter certification; assessed by capstone projects

beginner.summary: For testers and developers starting performance testing with Apache JMeter. Covers performance testing concepts and test types, installing JMeter, test plans and thread groups, HTTP samplers and config elements, recording scripts, listeners, assertions, timers and think time, parameterisation with CSV data, correlation with extractors, logic controllers and transactions, cookies, headers and sessions, testing REST APIs, running in non-GUI mode, the HTML dashboard report, reading results, basic server monitoring and a first load test report.
prerequisites: Understands how web applications and APIs work
Comfortable installing software and using a terminal
outcomes: Explain performance test types, workload terms and key metrics
Build realistic JMeter scripts with recording, parameterisation and correlation
Run tests in non-GUI mode and produce HTML dashboard reports
Read results with server metrics and write a clear first performance test report

days.topic: JMeter Overview, Performance Testing Concepts and Installation Setup
subtopics: Load, stress, spike, soak and capacity tests
Response time, throughput, errors and percentiles
The JMeter GUI and its parts
The course application and project overview
days.lab_task: Install JMeter and the Plugins Manager, open the GUI, run a sample test plan against the course application and explain each metric in the summary report.
days.deliverable: Working JMeter installation and explained metrics
checks: JMeter starts and the Plugins Manager is available
The sample plan runs and produces results
Response time, throughput and error rate are explained correctly

days.topic: Test Plans and Thread Groups
subtopics: Thread groups: threads, ramp-up and loops
Element scoping and order of execution
days.lab_task: Build a test plan with a setUp thread group that creates test data, a main thread group with ramp-up and duration, and a tearDown group that cleans up.
checks: The main group uses the planned users, ramp-up and duration
setUp and tearDown groups run in the right order
Every element has a meaningful name

days.topic: HTTP Request Samplers and Config Elements
days.lab_task: Script the home, search and product pages with HTTP samplers using request defaults, header, cookie and cache managers, and compare results with and without embedded resources.
checks: Host and protocol come from HTTP Request Defaults
Cookies and headers are handled by managers
Results with and without embedded resources are compared

days.topic: Recording Scripts with the HTTP(S) Test Script Recorder
subtopics: How the recorder works as a proxy
Excluding static resources and third parties
Recording with the BlazeMeter browser extension
When to write scripts by hand
days.lab_task: Record a login, search and add-to-cart journey through the recorder, exclude static and third-party requests, group steps into transactions and clean up the script.
checks: The journey is captured with all needed requests
Static and third-party requests are excluded
Steps are grouped into named transactions

days.topic: Listeners: Viewing and Saving Results
days.lab_task: Debug a script with View Results Tree, run a load test with only a Simple Data Writer, then load the JTL into Aggregate Report and compare percentiles.
checks: Request and response details are inspected in the tree
The load run writes only to a results file
Percentiles are read from the loaded results

days.topic: Assertions: Response, JSON, Duration and Size
days.lab_task: Add response, JSON, duration and size assertions to the script, run it under light load and show how failed assertions appear in error rates.
checks: Responses are checked for expected content
Failed assertions appear in the error rate

days.topic: Timers and Think Time
subtopics: Constant Timer and Uniform Random Timer
days.lab_task: Add realistic think time to the journey, then use a throughput timer to hold a target request rate and compare results with and without timers.
checks: The throughput timer holds the target rate
Results with and without timers are compared

days.topic: Parameterisation with CSV Data Set Config
days.lab_task: Parameterise logins and searches with a CSV file of users and terms, add unique values with functions and confirm that each thread uses different data.
checks: Each thread reads a different row
Unique values are produced with functions
The data file has enough rows for the planned load

days.topic: Correlation with Extractors: Regular Expression, JSON and Boundary
subtopics: What correlation is and why scripts fail without it
days.lab_task: Find the dynamic values in the recorded journey, extract the CSRF token, session ID and cart ID with suitable extractors and replay the script for ten users.
days.deliverable: Correlated script that replays for many users
checks: Ten users complete the journey without errors

days.topic: Logic Controllers and Transactions
days.lab_task: Model a user mix where 60 percent browse, 30 percent search and 10 percent buy, with transactions for each step, a login done once per user and a conditional checkout.
checks: The measured mix matches the planned percentages
Each step reports as a transaction
Checkout runs only when the cart has items

days.topic: Cookies, Headers, Authentication and Sessions
subtopics: OAuth tokens from a setUp step
days.lab_task: Script a token-based login once per thread, pass the token in headers, refresh it before expiry in a long test and keep credentials in a data file outside the script.
checks: Each thread logs in only once
Long runs refresh tokens without errors

days.topic: Testing REST APIs with JMeter
subtopics: API error rates and status codes
days.lab_task: Build an API load test for create, read and search operations with JSON bodies and extracted IDs, and run it at three load levels.
days.deliverable: API load test and results at three loads
checks: Each operation runs with valid bodies and headers
Created IDs are used in later requests
Response times are compared at three loads

days.topic: Non-GUI Mode and Command-Line Runs
subtopics: Why load tests run without the GUI
Generating the report at the end of a run
days.lab_task: Run the user mix test in non-GUI mode with users and duration passed as properties, write results and logs, and generate the HTML report from the command line.
checks: The test runs from the command line
Users and duration change through -J options
The HTML report is generated at the end
objectives: Run JMeter from the command line

days.topic: The HTML Dashboard Report
subtopics: Throughput and active threads over time
days.lab_task: Generate the HTML dashboard for a load run, set APDEX thresholds, find when response times started to rise and summarise the top three errors.
checks: APDEX thresholds match the agreed targets
The point where response times rise is identified
The top three errors are explained

days.topic: Reading Results: Percentiles, Throughput and Errors
subtopics: Throughput and its relation to users
days.lab_task: Compare three runs at different loads, calculate expected throughput with Little's law, find the saturation point and correct three misleading statements in a sample report.
checks: Percentiles and throughput are compared across runs
The saturation point is identified with evidence

days.topic: Server Monitoring During Tests
subtopics: Why client metrics are not enough
CPU, memory, disk and network on servers
Monitoring tools: OS tools, APM and dashboards
Matching server metrics to test time
days.lab_task: Monitor the application and database servers during a load test, line up server metrics with JMeter results and identify the first resource to saturate.
checks: Server metrics are captured for the test window
Server metrics are aligned with response times
The first saturated resource is named with evidence

days.topic: Database and Other Protocol Samplers
subtopics: JDBC Connection Configuration and JDBC Request
FTP, SMTP and TCP samplers in brief
When to test below the application
days.lab_task: Load test three slow database queries with JDBC samplers, compare their response times under concurrency and report which query needs tuning first.
checks: Each query's response time under load is recorded
The query to tune first is justified

days.topic: Debugging and Validating Scripts
days.lab_task: Diagnose four broken scripts (a failed correlation, an expired token, a missing header and an SSL error), fix them and write a validation checklist.
checks: Each failure has a recorded cause
All four scripts run without errors
The checklist covers the checks used

days.topic: Planning a Performance Test: Goals, Workload and Environment
days.lab_task: Write a performance test plan for the course application with goals, a workload model from sample analytics, environment notes, data needs and criteria.
checks: Goals are measurable service level objectives
The workload is based on analytics data
Environment differences and risks are listed

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Load Test and Report for an Online Store
days.lab_task: Plan and run a load test of an online store with a correlated, parameterised user mix in non-GUI mode at three loads, monitor the servers and write a report with findings and recommendations.
days.deliverable: Test plan, scripts, results and report
checks: The script replays the user mix without errors
Three load levels are run with server monitoring
The report states results against goals with recommendations

intermediate.summary: For performance testers who build JMeter scripts and now run professional load tests. Covers advanced workload models, JMeter plugins for thread groups and graphs, JSR223 with Groovy, modular test plans, distributed testing, real-time results with InfluxDB and Grafana, CI pipelines, Taurus, Docker, stress, spike and soak tests, capacity testing, bottleneck analysis with APM, database and caching effects, front-end performance, microservices, messaging, cloud load testing, results comparison and baselines, test data at scale and performance reporting to stakeholders.
prerequisites: Builds correlated and parameterised JMeter scripts
Runs tests in non-GUI mode and reads the HTML dashboard
outcomes: Design realistic workload models and run load, stress, spike, soak and capacity tests
Scale JMeter with distributed and containerised load generators
Monitor tests live and find bottlenecks with APM and server data
Automate performance tests in CI and report results against baselines

days.topic: Advanced Workload Modelling from Production Data
subtopics: Arrival rates compared with user counts
days.lab_task: Build a workload model from a week of sample access logs with peak rates, journey mix and arrival rates, and translate it into JMeter thread group settings.
checks: Peak hour and minute rates come from the logs
The journey mix matches the logs
Thread groups produce the modelled arrival rate

days.topic: JMeter Plugins: Concurrency, Arrivals and Ultimate Thread Groups
days.lab_task: Implement the workload model with an Arrivals Thread Group and a Throughput Shaping Timer, compare it with a standard thread group and make plugins available in CI.
checks: The arrival rate follows the planned profile
Differences from a standard thread group are explained
CI installs the same plugin versions

days.topic: JSR223 and Groovy Scripting in JMeter
subtopics: vars, props, prev and ctx objects
Generating data and signatures in Groovy
days.lab_task: Write Groovy scripts that generate signed request headers, validate a complex JSON response and set variables for later steps, and measure their cost under load.
checks: Script overhead is measured under load

days.topic: Modular Test Plans: Test Fragments, Include and Module Controllers
days.lab_task: Split the store test into reusable fragments for login, search and checkout, build two test plans from them and review a JMX change in Git.
days.deliverable: Modular test plans in version control
checks: Two test plans share the same fragments
Test plans are stored and reviewed in Git
A login change updates both plans

days.topic: Distributed Testing with Remote Load Generators
subtopics: When one machine is not enough
days.lab_task: Run a distributed test from one controller and three remote generators with separate data files, monitor the generators and confirm they are not the bottleneck.
checks: Each generator uses its own data file
Generator CPU and network stay within limits

days.topic: Real-Time Results with InfluxDB and Grafana
subtopics: Live response times, throughput and errors
days.lab_task: Send live results to InfluxDB with the Backend Listener, build a Grafana dashboard next to server metrics and annotate a test with ramp-up and peak phases.
checks: Results appear in InfluxDB during the run
The dashboard shows live response time, throughput and errors
Test phases are marked on the dashboard

days.topic: Performance Tests in CI Pipelines
subtopics: Where performance tests fit in CI
Short smoke load tests on each build
days.lab_task: Add a five-minute smoke load test to the pipeline with pass and fail criteria, a nightly larger test and published reports, and fail a build with a deliberate slowdown.
checks: The smoke load test runs on each build
The deliberate slowdown fails the build
Reports are linked from each run

days.topic: JMeter in Docker and Containerised Load Generators
subtopics: Building an image with plugins and data
days.lab_task: Build a JMeter image with plugins and the test plan, run it locally, scale to three containerised generators and collect results into one report.
checks: The image runs the test without extra setup
Results from all containers form one report

days.topic: Stress and Spike Testing
days.lab_task: Run a step stress test until errors rise sharply, then a spike test with a sudden tenfold jump, and record the breaking point and recovery time.
days.deliverable: Stress and spike results with breaking point
checks: The breaking point is identified with evidence
Spike behaviour and errors are recorded
Recovery time after overload is measured

days.topic: Soak and Endurance Testing
subtopics: Why some problems appear only over time
days.lab_task: Run a four-hour soak test at expected load, track memory, connections and response times over time and report any upward trends.
checks: The test runs for the planned duration
Memory and response time trends are charted
Any leak or degradation is reported with evidence

days.topic: Capacity and Scalability Testing
days.lab_task: Test how throughput changes from one to four application instances, check autoscaling behaviour under rising load and build a simple capacity model with headroom.
checks: Throughput per instance count is recorded
Scale-out timing and effect are measured
The model shows headroom for expected growth

days.topic: Bottleneck Analysis with APM and Profiling
subtopics: From slow response to root cause
days.lab_task: Use APM traces, thread dumps and query statistics to find the cause of a slow checkout under load, propose a fix with developers and retest to confirm the gain.
checks: The slow step is located in APM traces
The root cause is confirmed with evidence
Response times improve after the fix

days.topic: Databases, Caches and Their Effect on Performance Tests
subtopics: Database size and realistic data volumes
days.lab_task: Compare results with cold and warm caches and with small and production-like data volumes, and report how much each factor changes response times.
checks: Cold and warm cache results are recorded
Small and large data results are recorded
The effect of each factor is quantified

days.topic: Front-End Performance Alongside JMeter
subtopics: Combining protocol load with browser measurements
days.lab_task: Run a JMeter load test while measuring page experience with Lighthouse for three pages, and report how back-end load changes Core Web Vitals.
checks: Lighthouse results are recorded under load
Vitals with and without load are compared

days.topic: Testing Microservices and Messaging Under Load
subtopics: Testing one service in isolation with stubs
Message queues and Kafka under load
JMS and Kafka samplers or plugins
days.lab_task: Load test an order flow across three services and a Kafka topic, isolate one service with stubs and identify which service or queue limits throughput.
days.deliverable: Microservice load results and limiting component
checks: The isolated service's limit is measured
The limiting service or queue is named with evidence

days.topic: Cloud Load Testing Services
subtopics: When to use a cloud load testing service
Running JMX files in the cloud
Azure Load Testing and similar services
days.lab_task: Run the store test from a cloud load testing service in two regions, reach a private environment through the service's network options and compare cost and effort with self-hosted generators.
checks: The JMX test runs from two regions
The private environment is tested through the service
Cost and effort are compared with self-hosted runs

days.topic: Baselines, Comparisons and Regression Detection
days.lab_task: Create a baseline from three repeat runs, compare a new build automatically against it with thresholds and investigate one detected regression.
days.deliverable: Baseline, comparison script and regression note
checks: The baseline uses repeat runs with noise measured
The comparison flags changes beyond thresholds

days.topic: Test Data at Scale for Performance Tests
days.lab_task: Generate data for a one-hour test at peak load, split it across generators without overlap, plan the reset and show how stale data distorted a previous run.
days.deliverable: Data plan, generated data and analysis
checks: Data covers the full test without reuse conflicts

days.topic: Reporting Performance Results to Stakeholders
subtopics: Audiences: developers, managers and business owners
days.lab_task: Write a performance report for a release with an executive summary, results against objectives, bottlenecks, risks and a go or no-go recommendation, and present it to role-played stakeholders.
checks: The summary states results against objectives in plain words
The go or no-go advice is justified

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Performance Test Campaign for a Release
days.lab_task: Run a performance campaign for a release: build the workload model, modular scripts and live dashboards, run load, stress and soak tests on scaled generators, analyse bottlenecks and present a recommendation.
checks: The workload model is based on data
Load, stress and soak tests complete with monitoring
The recommendation follows from results and bottlenecks

advanced.summary: For performance engineers and leads who own performance across systems and teams. Covers performance engineering strategy, service level objectives and error budgets, performance requirements, architecture risk reviews, JMeter at scale, JMeter DSL and code-based tools, k6 and Gatling alongside JMeter, continuous performance testing, production-like environments, chaos under load, capacity planning, cloud cost and performance, database and JVM tuning partnerships, observability-driven analysis, testing in production, mobile and API back ends, AI-assisted analysis, governance, team enablement and troubleshooting.
prerequisites: Has run full performance campaigns with JMeter
Understands monitoring, APM and system architecture
Works with development and operations teams on fixes
outcomes: Set performance engineering strategy, objectives and governance
Run performance testing continuously and at scale across tools
Plan capacity and cost with evidence from tests and production
Lead performance analysis with developers, operations and leadership

days.topic: Performance Engineering Strategy for an Organisation
subtopics: Performance testing compared with performance engineering
days.lab_task: Assess performance practices for four systems, write a performance engineering strategy with ownership and a one-year roadmap, and present it to engineering leaders.
checks: Each system has a maturity and risk rating
The roadmap has phases and measures

days.topic: Service Level Objectives, Error Budgets and Performance Requirements
subtopics: Handling objectives that are not met
days.lab_task: Define SLIs and SLOs for three critical journeys from business needs and production data, map tests to them and agree an error budget policy with role-played owners.
days.deliverable: SLO set, test mapping and budget policy
checks: Each journey has measurable SLIs and SLOs
Owners accept the error budget policy

days.topic: Architecture Performance Risk Reviews
subtopics: Chatty services and N plus one calls
days.lab_task: Review a proposed architecture for performance risks, estimate component load from the workload model and turn the top risks into targeted tests.
days.deliverable: Risk review and targeted test plan
checks: At least five performance risks are found

days.topic: JMeter at Scale: Large Distributed Tests and Generator Fleets
subtopics: JVM and OS tuning for JMeter
days.lab_task: Plan and run a test at ten times normal load on a fleet of tuned generators, keep results volume manageable and confirm generators were not the bottleneck.
days.deliverable: Large test plan, run results and generator evidence
checks: Generator count and size follow the plan
The large test reaches the target load

days.topic: JMeter DSL and Performance Tests in Code
days.lab_task: Convert the store test to JMeter DSL in Java, run it from JUnit in CI with assertions on percentiles and compare maintenance with the JMX version.
checks: The DSL test reproduces the JMX workload

days.topic: k6 and Gatling Alongside JMeter
subtopics: Strengths of k6, Gatling and JMeter
days.lab_task: Implement the same API load test in k6, Gatling and JMeter, compare results, resource use and scripting effort, and write a tool choice guide.
days.deliverable: Three implementations and a tool guide
checks: All three tests produce comparable load
Results, resource use and effort are compared
The guide recommends tools per team type

days.topic: Continuous Performance Testing
days.lab_task: Design and implement continuous performance testing for a service with per-change checks, nightly comparisons against baselines and alerts to the owning team.
checks: Each change runs a short performance check

days.topic: Production-Like Environments and Their Limits
subtopics: Why test environments differ from production
Infrastructure as code for test environments
Mocks and their effect on results
Testing in production as a complement
days.lab_task: Compare a test environment with production, decide what can be extrapolated, build a scaled environment with infrastructure as code and state the confidence limits in the report.
days.deliverable: Environment comparison, scaled environment and limits statement
checks: Differences are listed with their likely effects
The scaled environment is created from code
The report states what results can and cannot predict

days.topic: Chaos and Resilience Under Load
subtopics: Why failures behave differently under load
days.lab_task: Inject an instance failure and a slow dependency during a load test, measure error rates and recovery and report whether recovery objectives were met.
checks: Faults are injected at planned times
Error rates and recovery times are recorded
Results are compared with recovery objectives

days.topic: Capacity Planning from Test and Production Data
days.lab_task: Build a twelve-month capacity plan for a service from test results, production metrics and growth forecasts, with headroom, scaling triggers and risks.
checks: The plan combines test and production data
Headroom policies and triggers are defined
Risks are stated for operations and leadership

days.topic: Cloud Cost and Performance Optimisation
days.lab_task: Test a service on two instance types and two autoscaling policies, calculate cost per transaction for each and recommend the best balance of cost and performance.
days.deliverable: Cost and performance comparison with recommendation
checks: Cost per transaction is calculated for each
The recommendation balances cost and objectives

days.topic: Database and JVM Performance Partnerships
subtopics: JVM heap and garbage collection tuning
days.lab_task: With role-played developers and a DBA, tune a connection pool, a query index and JVM settings one change at a time, measuring each change with a repeatable test.

days.topic: Observability-Driven Performance Analysis
subtopics: Metrics, logs and traces in analysis
Exemplars and trace links from metrics
days.lab_task: Tag load test requests with trace context, follow the slowest traces through services, form and test a hypothesis about the cause and present the findings.
checks: The hypothesis is confirmed or rejected with data

days.topic: Performance Testing in Production and Real User Monitoring
subtopics: Comparing test and real user results
days.lab_task: Design safe synthetic checks and a controlled load test in production with approvals and a kill switch, and compare test results with real user monitoring data.
days.deliverable: Production test plan, results and comparison
checks: Approvals and a kill switch are in place
Synthetic and controlled tests run as planned
Test and real user results are compared

days.topic: Performance of Mobile and API Back Ends
days.lab_task: Model mobile traffic for an API with realistic payloads and network conditions, test the gateway's rate limits and caching and report the effect on mobile users.
days.deliverable: Mobile back-end test results and report
checks: The workload reflects mobile traffic patterns
Rate limits and caching behaviour are measured

days.topic: AI-Assisted Performance Analysis
subtopics: Generating scripts from traffic with AI help
days.lab_task: Use an AI assistant to summarise a large results set and suggest causes, verify each suggestion against the data and record which were right, wrong or unproven.
days.deliverable: AI summary, verification record and rules
checks: The AI summary is produced from real results
Each suggestion is checked against data
Team rules for AI use are written

days.topic: Governance for Performance Engineering
subtopics: Standards for scripts, data and reports
Approvals for large and production tests
days.lab_task: Write performance standards and approval rules, review three existing test assets against them and define performance gates in the release process.
days.deliverable: Standards, review results and release gates
checks: Standards cover scripts, data, runs and reports
Three assets are reviewed and fixed

days.topic: Building a Performance Engineering Team and Practice
days.lab_task: Design a performance engineering practice with roles, an engagement model for product teams, a training plan for developers and measures of success.
checks: The engagement model states how teams request help
The training plan covers developers and testers

days.topic: Troubleshooting Performance Test Problems
subtopics: Results that do not make sense
Data and correlation errors under load
days.lab_task: Diagnose four problem runs (generator saturation, a correlation failure under load, a network limit and inconsistent repeats), fix the tests and write a troubleshooting guide.
checks: Each problem has a confirmed cause
Rerun results are consistent after fixes
The guide covers the steps used

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Performance Engineering Programme for a Platform
days.lab_task: Design a performance engineering programme for a platform with SLOs, continuous testing, large-scale and resilience tests, a capacity and cost plan and governance, run the key tests and present the programme to leadership.
days.deliverable: Programme plan, test results and presentation
checks: Key tests run with results against objectives
